newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hariri to Rome before pope's visit to Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Hariri to Rome before pope's visit to Lebanon.

text.p: Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri will make a three-day visit to Rome starting on Sunday before an expected visit by Pope John Paul II to Lebanon in May, official sources said on Friday.

Hariri will meet Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro and other Italian officials as well as the pope, the sources added. He will discuss bilateral relations and Italy's contribution in Lebanon's reconstruction with the Italian officials, the sources said.

Italy is Lebanon's biggest trading partner and one of the biggest financial contributors to its reconstruction. Major Italian companies are involved in Lebanese reconstruction, particularly in rehabilitating the electricity network.
The Vatican has not officially announced a date for the pope's visit to Lebanon but Monsignor Pablo Puente, the papal nuncio in Beirut, said last week it would probably take place in May.
The Vatican cancelled a five-day visit by Pope John Paul to Lebanon scheduled for May 1994 after the bombing of a Maronite church north of Beirut killed 11 Sunday worshippers and injured 59.
